    • Method Detail

      • baseUri

        @Nullable
java.net.URI baseUri()
        Returns the base URI configured at the REST client level. The base URI is used to construct the full requestUri(). May be null if the REST client does not have a base URI and the path is an absolute URI.

      • requestUri

        @Lazy
default java.net.URI requestUri()
        Returns the full URI of this request. The URI is constructed from the base URI, path, and query parameters. It cannot be modified directly.
